slides.sub: Read the auction, not the candle.

slides.title: Stacked buy imbalances
slides.body: Ask volume at least 3x the bid one tick below, on 3+ consecutive prices. That's aggressive initiative buying, not retail noise.

slides.title: Absorption at the low
slides.body: Huge selling hits the bid, but price refuses to go lower. Someone big is buying every contract with limit orders.

slides.title: Exhaustion at the high
slides.body: Volume dries up tick after tick into the high. No one is left to buy higher prices.

slides.title: Unfinished auction
slides.body: Bid AND ask trade at the extreme of the bar. The auction didn't complete, so price often comes back to finish the job.
slides.tip: Clean high: 0 on one side. Unfinished high: trades on both sides. Expect a revisit.

4 footprint signals institutions can't hide 🔍

Candles show you WHERE price went. The footprint shows you WHO pushed it there.

1️⃣ Stacked imbalances: initiative buyers/sellers
2️⃣ Absorption: limit orders soaking up aggression
3️⃣ Exhaustion: volume dying into the extreme
4️⃣ Unfinished auction: a magnet for a revisit
